title: 7) Christian Religious Education-2
text:
THE KENYA NATIONAL EXAMINATIONS COUNCIL
 SCHOOL BASED ASSESSMENT
 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
 (For Regular Learners, Learners with Physical Disabilities and Learners
 with Hearing Impairments)
 Grade 4 - 2024
LEARNER’S NAME: _____________________________________________ GRADE: ___________
ASSESSMENT NO: _______________________________ DATE: ____________________________
SCHOOL NAME: ____________________________________________________________________
INSTRUCTIONS TO LEARNERS
 1. This paper consists of 30 questions.
 2. Answer Question in the spaces provided.
 Time: 1 Hour

 This paper consists of 6 pages.
Learners should check the question paper to ascertain that all the pages are printed as
indicated and no questions are missing.
1. Grade Four learners read the Bible on the creation of human beings. They realized that
 human beings are special from the rest of the creation. What makes human beings special?
2. During a CRE lesson, your teacher asked you to name members of the nuclear family. Write
 one member of the nuclear family______________________________________________
3. You read the story of Amnon and Tamar in the Bible. Your teacher of CRE asked you how
 you would protect yourself from sexual abuse. Write one answer that you gave
4. After learning about making choices, some learners carried out the following activities over
 the weekend:
 i. Terry- Listened to gospel music over the radio.
 iii. Rose- Fetched firewood for her grandmother.
 From the above activities, who among the learners made the best choice? ______________
5. When God put human beings in the Garden of Eden, he told them to eat the fruits in the
 Garden. Choose an attribute of God that is shown by this statement.
 i. Judge.
 ii. Provider.
 iii. Protector.
6. Your teacher of CRE put you in small groups to arrange the books of the Bible into either
 Old or New Testament. Some of the books included: Romans, Numbers, Timothy, and
 Revelation.
 From this list, choose one book of the Old Testament and write it.
7. During a CRE lesson, you read the Bible about the story of Joseph and the dreams of the
 king in Egypt. The reason why Joseph was able to interpret the dreams of the king was
 because
 i. he was an Israelite.
 ii. he was intelligent.
 iii. God gave him wisdom.
8. Grade Four learners discussed in groups the story of Jonah and the big fish. From that story,
 you learnt that you should____________________________________________________
9. A pastor discussed with your class the story in which three Hebrew men were thrown into
 the fire for their faith in God. From that story, write the name of one of them.
10. Who among the following people in the Bible is correctly matched with an event in his life?
 Name Event
 i. Elijah ---------------------------Healed Naaman of leprosy.
 ii. Samuel ------------------------ Was taken to heaven in chariot of fire.
 iii. David---------------------------Killed Goliath.
11. Your teacher put you in small groups to discuss the stories of the annunciation of the birth
 of John the Baptist and Jesus Christ. You were asked to list similarities in both stories. Write
 one similarity you found _____________________________________________________
12. Your class read the Bible on the story in which the boy Jesus at the age of twelve years
 accompanied his parents to the temple for the Passover festival. What do you learn about
 Jesus when he accepted to go back home with his parents ___________________________
13. You read the Bible on the baptism of Jesus in River Jordan. Your teacher asked you to list
 the events that took place during that baptism. Write one of those events.
14. During break time, Grade Three learners were playing in the field. One of them accidentally
 hit Eric and he fell down. Write the best action that Eric should take as a Christian.
15. During the weekend, your Sunday school teacher took you for an outing. You were to carry
 your own snacks. While you were eating, you noticed a girl who had nothing to eat. As a
 Christian, what is the correct action for you to take?
 i. Move away from her.
 ii. Tell your friends about it.
 iii. Share what you have with her.
16. The town where Jesus performed the miracle of changing water into wine is called -
17. Grade Four learners read a story in the Bible about the call of the first disciples and noted
 that Jesus performed a miracle. Choose the miracle which Jesus performed
 i. The miracle of calming the storm.
 ii. The miraculous catch of fish.
 iii. The miracle of walking on water.
18. A pastor was invited to talk to your class about the parable of the mustard seed. He said that
 the kingdom of God grows from a small beginning. As a Christian, write one activity that
 you can take part in to lead to the growth of the church.
19. Christians celebrate Easter once every year to remember the death and resurrection of Jesus
 Christ. An activity that is carried out in the church to remember the death of Jesus is
 i. Giving offerings.
 ii. Decorating the church.
 iii. Taking Holy Communion.
20. A teacher forgot her handbag in class as she went out for lunch. When she came back, she
 found that her money was missing. She asked the learners about it, but they said they had
 not seen it. The Christian value that learners in that class should develop is
21. During the school assemblies, your teachers normally tell you to clean your clothes and
 bodies regularly. The Christian value that your teachers are developing in the learners is
 i. Patience.
 ii. Gentleness.
 iii. Holiness.
22. On your way to school, you lost your pen. Your desk mate who had two pens gave you one
 to use in class. What should you tell your desk mate? _______________________________
23. Kelvin, a Grade Four learner has a habit of dusting the teacher’s table every morning. The
 Christian value he demonstrates is _____________________________________________
24. As Jesus was passing through Jericho, Bartimaeus the blind man shouted, “Jesus have mercy
 on me.” Select a Christian value that Bartimaeus demonstrated.
 i. Kindness.
 ii. Love.
 iii. Courage.
25. Jesus went to the temple and chased away the people who were selling things there. Write
 one way you show respect for the house of God during worship _____________________
26. After a class discussion on worship in the Early Church, your teacher asked learners to write
 similar activities that were carried out in the Early Church and the church today. Write one
 activity that is similar in both _________________________________________________
27. The town where believers were first called Christians is called _______________________
28. During a CRE lesson you recited the Lord’s Prayer. Your teacher asked you to say the
 importance of prayer in the life of a Christian. Write the answer you would give_______
29. The circles below contain the gifts and fruit of the Holy Spirit. Choose one that contains only
 the fruit of the Holy Spirit.
 Circle W Circle Y Circle Z
 Tolerance Courage Peace
 Cooperation Respect Humility
30. Your teacher of CRE asked your class to summarize the social media activities which they
 carried out during the school holidays. Some learners wrote the following:
 i. Gloria- Listening to online sermons.
 ii. Brian- Chatting online with friends.
 iii. Ann- Playing computer games.
 Who among the above learners was most likely to acquire Christian values from the social
 media?
